tasks.story: As a user who just finished or wants to exit a guided lesson, I want an explicit control to return to editing so that I don't have to discover by accident that clicking the grid already works.
tasks.title: Add Stop/Continue-editing control
constraints: Not a state-machine change. Wire a new onStopLesson prop straight to the existing setGuideCompose() already exported from usePattern.ts.
Do not add a new GuideStatus value, do not touch derivePasses/passState in src/lib/guidance.ts.
Matches existing action-strip button styling (tbtn class), no new visual language.
tasks.acceptance: From "complete" or "paused" status, clicking the new control lands in "compose" status with the grid editable — same observable result as the existing "click the grid to restart" path. Guided ("guided" status) editing remains blocked, unchanged.
tasks.result: Added onStopLesson prop threaded App.tsx -> LessonPanel.tsx -> LayerStack.tsx, wired to pattern.setGuideCompose(). New 'Continue editing' tbtn renders when status is paused or complete, alongside the existing Restart button. No new GuideStatus value, no changes to guidance.ts. Verified live: drove a kick+bass pattern through Start guidance -> Next row x2 to reach complete (2/2 passes), clicked Continue editing, header flipped to COMPOSE · 0/2 passes with the grid cell showing ACTIVE (editable) state. Paused-status rendering verified by code read only (same JSX branch and handler as complete; not driven live because reaching paused requires mid-playback transport pause).
